observations.result: No-grant Worker omits commands. Read-only resource descriptors have exact required bookId/collectionId schemas and are disabled. Library-write-only cannot open a book even on shelf (reader-control; execution ui/unavailable), but can open a collection. Fully granted Worker opens both.
Fully granted Worker missing book returned reader/book-not-found; missing collection returned ui/target-not-found. IDs are resource arguments, not row IDs or labels.

Book-scope open-book returned completed [reading] after synthetic FB2 readiness. Global open-collection returned completed [workspace] and the actual owned collection. Calls use production tool construction/runtime dependencies, not autonomous model reasoning.

observations.case: Native palette persistence failure and recovery
observations.result: Targeted BEFORE UPDATE trigger capability_command_routing_reject rejected read-aware-shelf-view. Actual Switch to list view click left search open at revision 9, aria-busy false, grid retained and no settings.changed. Removing the trigger and retrying saved list, closed search at revision 10, and emitted exactly one settings.changed with origin=user.

Querying the owned book title and clicking the native palette result opened the real reader and closed search (revision 15). From reading, querying Workspace Probe Collection and clicking the collection result returned to that shelf collection with search closed (revision 18).

Library Desk 0.5 Workspace > Host commands search Open book led to a query-backed resource picker. Clicking owned book 1 opened FB2 and eventually closed only the plugin dialog. Reopening the compiled plugin and searching Open collection led to its collection picker; selecting the owned collection returned to shelf, dialog closed, revision 20.

Unit test first reproduced an aborted navigation whose delayed shell lookup could still begin a session. Controller now revokes that intent on abort/deadline and close-before-session. Workspace adapter recognizes a pending opening, refuses cancellation without reading control, and cancels it before authorized non-overlay navigation. Exact held-lookup window is unit, not native E2E evidence.

knownFailure.result: Native SQL refusal showed both Change not saved / localized database message and a second localized command error toast. No raw SQL message was shown. Storage and caller presentation ownership remains unresolved and is recorded in UI03.

inventoryBoundary: Removed ten obsolete CommandActions callbacks; added independent enumeration and explicit per-ID mapping for all 18 HOST_COMMAND_IDS. A regression mutates the catalog with an unmapped test ID and requires collection to fail. This is not whole-product semantic completeness proof.
captureBoundary: First reader capture preceded settled native paint and had stale shelf content; it was inspected but not accepted as final UI evidence. Foregrounding the owned app and later captures showed the native collection result, resource picker and actual reader. UI sizes were 1200x800 and 800x650 logical pixels; document horizontal overflow was false at 800.
boundaries: UI03 remains partial: import task results, cross-plugin invocation, remaining native entrypoints, complete availability/observation and focus are not closed.
Explicit dismissal/unmount, reopened palette isolation, partial result and duplicate activation are covered by isolated React tests; not all concurrency windows were driven in Tauri.
Open-book waits reading readiness, not clearing unrelated settings/search overlays. Cancellation does not roll back already applied rendering/history effects.
No packaged build, Windows/Linux, full installation consent, remote-race or large-library performance proof in this unit.
Existing bridge-version/compile warnings and initial WebView termination/reboot are not claimed fixed.
